name: Big Pine Key RV Park
note: Formerly Big Pine Key Fishing Lodge, at mile marker 33 on Spanish Harbor, with a canal, boat ramp and boat basin. The rustic (no-hookup) sites are 20 ft long, so book a hookup site. The pool and rec center are closed for rebuilding from Oct 19, 2026, for about 12 weeks. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page covecommunities.com/rv-resorts/florida/big-pine-key-rv read 2026-10-30 (Cove Communities RV resort: full-hookup back-in, canal and oceanfront RV sites plus rustic tent sites, camper and cottage rentals, front desk 305-872-2351) and its April 2026 site map (RV sites 1-102 and 205-272, no home or lot section); Cove's booking engine (bookings.covecommunities.com/AvailabilityPark.aspx?resparkid=14543) on 2026-10-30 sold a 23-ft Class C one night on Tue Jan 12 2027, Tue Dec 29 2026, Tue Feb 16 2027, Sat Mar 13 2027 and Tue Jun 15 2027 with no minimum message; Cove's homes-for-sale index lists no homes at this park; Good Sam directory types it RV_PARK (a Good Sam Park), not a condo park; Google Maps open, 4.6/1,129, phone matches -> real transient RV resort; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's April 2026 site map puts 'Oceanfront Full Hook-up' sites 20-24, 99 and 100 and the oceanfront rustic row along the park's east shore on Spanish Harbor Channel, and canal sites 1-19 along the canal under US-1, and the engine sells an 'Oceanfront Full Hookup' type. That claim only triggered the audit. The Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 600 m frame at 24.6478,-81.3318 and 220 m frame at 24.6476,-81.3296) shows the east edge as a riprap shore on Spanish Harbor. This is natural open salt water several hundred metres across, running under the Spanish Harbor bridge to open water beyond, not a dredged canal. RVs on the east row sit about 15-35 m from the riprap on open sand, with only a fire pit and scattered palms between and no road, lot or treeline, so the campground's own frontage is an open apron within the distance bound. The north canal is a dredged channel about 25-35 m wide behind a seawall that opens onto Spanish Harbor at the park's NE corner; it is not needed for the call.
fees_source: bookings.covecommunities.com/AvailabilityPark.aspx?resparkid=14543 read 2026-10-30, RV Site, Motor Class C 23 ft, 2 adults, 1 night Tue Jan 12 2027: Full Hookup Back-In 30 Amp $187.95 (checkout summary: 1 night $187.95 + taxes $23.50 = $211.45, no resort or grounds fee); same night 50 Amp $193, Oceanfront Full Hookup $246, Canal Full Hookup $257. Other nights, 30-amp back-in: Tue Dec 29 2026 $208, Tue Feb 16 2027 $197, Sat Mar 13 2027 $248, Tue Jun 15 2027 $100. Rustic $99 (Jan) is not used because rustic sites are 20 ft.
flags: Cheapest in-season night is $188 before 12.5% tax (30-amp back-in, Tue Jan 12 2027); a March Saturday is $248; June drops to $100.
No minimum stay: single nights sold in Dec (between Christmas and New Year), Jan, Feb, a March Saturday and June. The '3-night minimum' on the Cove site belongs only to a 25% discount special.
Rustic and oceanfront rustic sites are 20 ft (engine description), under EKKO's 23 ft; the hookup sites are 'spacious gravel pads to accommodate any size RV'.

Run by Cove Communities (Phoenix), which also runs 55+ manufactured-home communities, but this park has no homes or lots for sale (it is absent from Cove's homes-for-sale index) and the site map is all RV/tent sites plus a few camper rentals.
Peak season is nearly full: 'Only 1 remaining' on the 30-amp type for Feb 16 2027 and Mar 13 2027.
Good Sam Park (isGsPark true, military true) per the Good Sam directory cache; RV Life lists Good Sam and Passport America affiliations. Cove offers veterans 15% off daily stays.
RV Life 8.26/10 from 47 ratings (given as 4.1*); the candidate record carried no star value.
